Starting from 19 August 2024, Stock Connect Northbound Shareholding information will only be available on a quarterly basis. Information in respect of the preceding quarter will be published on the 5th Northbound trading day following the quarter end.

Shareholding information displayed represents the shareholdings of CCASS Participants in aggregate as at the end of the specified date, on the assumption that the related money settlement has been duly completed. If the specified shareholding date is a Sunday or a Hong Kong public holiday, shareholding information on the preceding day which is not a Sunday or Hong Kong public holiday will be displayed.

This Stock Connect shareholding search facility will only display shareholding information from 17 March 2017. Information as on the shareholding date will be available for a period of 12 months.

Search

Note:

1. The total number of A shares listed and traded on the SZSE of the relevant SZSE-listed company used for calculating the percentage of shareholding may not have taken into account any change in connection with or as a result of any corporate actions of the relevant company and hence, may not be up-to-date. The percentage of shareholding is for reference only.
2. The total number of A shares listed and traded on the SZSE of the relevant SZSE-listed company used for calculating the percentage of shareholding may not be equal to the actual total number of issued shares of that company.

Please refer to the SZSE website (Click here) for the "total number of issued shares" of the SZSE-listed companies (including any A shares, B shares, H shares and other non-circulating shares) should you require the information for the purpose of monitoring the foreign shareholding restriction requirement in China or otherwise.
3. The list of stocks shown is not a list of eligible securities for Northbound Trading under Shenzhen Connect. For information relating to eligible securities, please visit the relevant HKEX website http://www.hkex.com.hk/eng/csm/securities_eligible_stocks.htm.
4. Only A shares shareholding information is displayed below.
